import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs/task-83cef9ec.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The repeated figure is the compact multi-cell motif; isolated marker cells
    # indicate where its distinguished cell is copied.
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    # Find the compact, dense colored component used as the stamp.
    unseen=set(pts); comps=[]
    while unseen:
        q=[unseen.pop()]; comp=[]
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop(); comp.append((r,c))
            for z in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if z in unseen: unseen.remove(z); q.append(z)
        comps.append(comp)
    # A template is normally the largest connected component; single-cell
    # repetitions are the destinations.
    template=max(comps,key=len)
    tr=[r for r,c in template]; tc=[c for r,c in template]
    r0,r1=min(tr),max(tr); c0,c1=min(tc),max(tc)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0):grid[r][c] for r,c in template}
    # Find the anchor color: the cell in the template whose color is used at
    # marker locations, favoring the interior and any repeated singleton color.
    singles=[co[0] for co in comps if len(co)==1 and grid[co[0][0]][co[0][1]]!=bg]
    if not singles: return a
    marker_color=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in singles).most_common(1)[0][0]
    anchors=[(dr,dc) for (dr,dc),v in shape.items() if v==bg]
    if not anchors:
        anchors=[(dr,dc) for (dr,dc),v in shape.items() if v==marker_color]
    if not anchors: anchors=[( (r1-r0)//2,(c1-c0)//2 )]
    ar,ac=anchors[0]
    for r,c in singles:
        if grid[r][c]!=marker_color: continue
        for (dr,dc),v in shape.items():
            rr,cc=r+dr-ar,c+dc-ac
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: a[rr][cc]=v
    return a
'''
